name: Speak
description: Read text aloud to the user through a swappable speech backend. Tools: Speak, SpeakStatus, SpeakStop.

tool.name: Speak
tool.description: Read text aloud to the user through the computer speakers. Use it when the user asks to hear an answer, or when a short spoken alert helps. Do not use it for code, a raw URL, a table or dense markdown. Do not narrate a written answer that the user reads. Returns a job handle at once, and the speech plays while you keep working.

text.description: The text to read aloud. Plain prose works best. Markdown syntax, code, and raw URLs are read literally and sound bad, so paraphrase them into speech-friendly wording first. Max 8000 characters. The voice reads the text literally, so use plain sentences and strip markdown.

wait.description: When false (default), return immediately with a job handle and let the speech play in the background while you continue. When true, block until the speech finishes (or the per-call time budget is hit) before returning. Use `true` only for a short line you want confirmed as fully spoken before you move on, never for long passages, which would stall the turn.

tool.reason: SpeakSpeak is a stutter, name already carries plugin identity

tool.name: SpeakStatus
tool.description: Report whether speech is playing. Use it before you decide to wait, to speak again, or to stop a job. Do not use it to silence a job, use SpeakStop for that. Returns the state of one job, or the state of every job in this session.

id.description: A speech job handle returned by Speak (e.g. `s1`). Omit to get the state of all jobs in this session.

tool.reason: SpeakSpeakStatus is verbose, name already carries plugin identity

tool.name: SpeakStop
tool.description: Stop speech that is playing. Use it the moment the user says stop, or when you spoke the wrong thing. Do not use it to check whether a job is still talking, use SpeakStatus for that. Returns that the job stopped, and a no-op note when the job had already finished.

id.description: A speech job handle returned by Speak (e.g. `s1`). Omit to stop every active speech job in this session.

tool.reason: SpeakSpeakStop is verbose, name already carries plugin identity
